name: pan pacific plastics mfg inc
old_description: Founded in 1981 and headquartered in Northern California, Pan Pacific manufactures and imports a full line of packaging, specifically producing various types of bags made from paper and plastic. In Hayward, CA we do all the plastic extruding, printing and converting in our expanded manufacturing facility. In addition, we have several manufacturing partnerships located throughout Asia offering unlimited paper and plastic products and capacities.
about:
Founded in 1981 in Hayward, California, Pan Pacific Plastics Mfg Inc is a woman-owned and minority-certified packaging manufacturer. The company began as a domestic producer of paper and plastic bags and later expanded with overseas manufacturing partnerships across Asia.

The company manufactures and imports a full line of packaging, specializing in bags made from paper and plastic. At its Hayward facility, Pan Pacific performs plastic extrusion, printing, and converting in an expanded manufacturing plant. Through its Asian partnerships, it offers additional capacity for paper and plastic products. The firm maintains an in-house graphic art department for artwork proofs and design support, and operates quality control inspections at both factory and warehouse levels.

Pan Pacific serves a broad range of industries, including grocery, retail, promotional, industrial, agricultural, food service, airline, travel, and hospitality. Its customer base includes major distributors and various Fortune 500 companies, as well as small businesses and individual consumers worldwide.

Pan Pacific emphasizes complete control over every production step—domestically and overseas—to ensure quality and consistency. It differentiates itself with low domestic minimums (as little as 100 lbs of plastic), short domestic lead times of four to six weeks, price protection programs that lock in pricing for up to a year, and a responsive customer support model backed by over 100 years of combined staff experience.
